summary: Sniper Elite entries from Sami's spine and sourced supplemental seeds, built for per-platform route research.

entries.title: Sniper Elite

sami.notes: WII Exclusive Flak Tower Mission | Exclusive Flak Tower Mission

entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC full run plus Wii bonus level

emulation.emulator: None for primary; Dolphin for Wii secondary
emulation.notes: Use native Windows for the main run. Use Dolphin or Wii hardware only for the bonus level.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PC capture for the full run, Wii/Dolphin for the exclusive cleanup.

primary.version: Sniper Elite / Berlin 1945 on Windows, Steam rerelease acceptable
primary.why: Sami chose PC. The Windows release has the cleanest capture path and PC compatibility tooling, while the Wii release is only needed for its sourced bonus level.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC version natively, applying compatibility fixes if needed. After the PC run, play only the Wii bonus level for completion cleanup.

secondary.exclusive_content: Wii bonus level; Sami's sheet names this extra mission Flak Tower.
secondary.what_to_play: Play only the Wii bonus level after the Windows PC full run.
secondary.why: The Wii release adds a bonus new level, so the archive route keeps PC as the full run and Wii as a short secondary cleanup.

entries.remaster_caveats: The 2012 Steam rerelease is still the original Windows game; it does not replace the need to check the Wii bonus level for archive completeness.

entries.title: Sniper Elite 3
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC with owned mission DLC / Ultimate Edition content checklist

primary.version: Sniper Elite III on Windows with owned mission DLC installed
primary.why: Sami chose PC. Windows is the highest-fidelity capture route, and for the Ultimate Edition/DLC, the completion checklist is DLC ownership rather than a separate platform route.
primary.how_to_play: Install the Windows version and any owned mission DLC, especially the Save Churchill campaign content, then capture natively at the target resolution/settings.

entries.remaster_caveats: Ultimate Edition bundles the main game with additional DLC packs, including the Save Churchill mission pack; verify DLC ownership on PC before calling the run complete.

entries.title: Sniper Elite 4
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC Digital Deluxe or base game plus Season Pass

primary.version: Sniper Elite 4 Digital Deluxe / Windows with Season Pass campaign DLC installed
primary.why: Sami chose PC. Windows gives the highest settings/capture ceiling, and the Season Pass includes the extra campaign missions needed for a complete route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC version natively with the Season Pass or equivalent mission DLC installed, then capture the base campaign plus Target Fuhrer and Deathstorm missions.

entries.remaster_caveats: Later Switch and Apple releases are ports, not replacements for the PC archive route. Include the Season Pass campaign DLC for completion.

entries.title: Sniper Elite V2 Remastered
entries.definitive_edition: Sniper Elite V2 Remastered on Windows PC

primary.version: Sniper Elite V2 Remastered on Windows
primary.why: Sami chose PC. The remaster is the sourced modern package for this entry, with official sources describing included DLC, 4K/HDR support, photo mode, and new playable characters.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC remaster natively at the target capture settings. Treat the remaster package as the complete V2 route unless comparing the 2012 original historically.

entries.remaster_caveats: This entry is specifically the 2019 remaster, not the original 2012 Sniper Elite V2 release; do not add PS3, Xbox 360, or Wii U rows here.

entries.title: Sniper Elite VR

emulation.notes: Native PC VR route; check headset compatibility and comfort/capture settings before recording.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PC VR rendering and capture path.

primary.version: Sniper Elite VR on Windows PC / SteamVR-compatible headset
primary.why: Sami chose PC. Windows PC VR is the highest-fidelity capture route among the sourced VR platforms, while Quest and PSVR are hardware-convenience routes.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Windows PC VR release with the best available SteamVR-compatible headset and a stable VR capture pipeline; reserve Quest or PSVR only for hardware comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is the 2021 Sniper Elite VR entry; Winter Warrior is a separate Quest title already tracked separately.

entries.title: Sniper Elite 5
entries.definitive_edition: Sniper Elite 5 Complete Edition on Windows PC

primary.version: Sniper Elite 5 Complete Edition on Windows PC
primary.why: Sami chose PC. Windows offers the cleanest fidelity/capture route, and the Complete Edition sources include the base game plus Season Pass One and Two content for the most complete PC package.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Windows PC Complete Edition or install the base game plus Season Pass One and Two content, then capture natively at the target resolution/settings.

entries.remaster_caveats: Complete Edition is the package target because it includes Season Pass One and Two; the 2026 Apple versions are separate ports, not the chosen archive route.

entries.title: Sniper Elite VR Winter Warrior

primary.version: Sniper Elite VR: Winter Warrior on Meta Quest
primary.why: Sami sheet says PC, but release data shows Quest as the release platform. Until a PC VR version exists, the Quest release is the only primary route.
primary.how_to_play: Play on Meta Quest 2, Quest 3, or Quest Pro. Prefer Quest 3/3S-class hardware for the cleanest standalone capture path.

entries.remaster_caveats: Sheet platform conflict: Sami listed PC, but current sourced release data points to Quest-only availability.

entries.title: Sniper Elite Resistance
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC Deluxe Edition or base game plus Season Pass

primary.version: Sniper Elite: Resistance Deluxe Edition / Windows PC with Season Pass installed
primary.why: Sami chose PC. Windows offers the highest settings/capture ceiling, and the Deluxe/Season Pass content is needed for the complete route.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Windows PC version with the Deluxe Edition or Season Pass content installed, then capture the base campaign plus the Season Pass campaign missions.

entries.remaster_caveats: The Deluxe Edition includes the base game and Season Pass; confirm the Season Pass campaign missions are installed before marking a capture run complete.
